inputs.text: The “No Kings” rally turning volatile after federal officers arrived with tear gas and arrests is exactly how these situations get framed: officials move in, the streets erupt, and then the protesters are blamed as “agitators.” At least 13 arrests were confirmed, but the real question is who benefits from turning a mass anti-Trump protest into a story about chaos and control. I wouldn’t take the official narrative at face value.
